notes.title: UI update
notes.notes:
1. Optimize the login UI performance;
2. Optimized the game memory size;

notes.title: Add voice acting to the game
notes.notes:
1. The game has been added to the dubbing, currently only support Chinese voice.
2. Optimized and adjusted part of the story animation effect.

notes.title: Add the TV voice
notes.notes: Add TV voices to fine-tune the overall game picture.

notes.title: New picture settings of cartoon rendering.
notes.notes: The rendering effect can be selected in the menu settings interface.

notes.title: UI artistic adjustment.
notes.notes:
1.Optimized the artistic presentation of some UI.
2.Added character logs, which can be browsed in the level content of the menu interface. However, you need to clear the current level to unlock its story content.

notes.title: TheGameNowSupportsEnglish/Russian.
notes.notes:
1.Optimized the third-person fixed camera mode to now support camera rotation.

2.Improved the death count, changing the previous three-death system to a five-death system.

3.Addressed the save file issue where players had to watch the cutscene again after dying in the third level while being chased by a dog.

4.Modified the trigger time for the snail's acceleration ability, now requiring only one charge to release the boost.

5.Enhanced the UI visuals and strengthened the visual effects, while optimizing the clarity of some UI prompts that were previously faint.

6.Humanized the pause key to "ESC," but the key modification can be customized in the settings menu.

7.Improved the visual representation of certain level scenes.

8.Fixed some bugs where the AI was getting stuck.

9.Added English/Russian subtitles.

10.Due to the update involving save files, there is a possibility that save files for existing players may encounter issues. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

11.The game content will continue to be updated. Thank you for your support.

notes.title: Fixed BUG with Chicken Grill
notes.notes: In the second level BOSS battle, the Chicken Grill had a chance to get stuck on the middle toilet, fixed this issue to reduce the BUG probability of getting stuck.

notes.title: Modify the game 3C
notes.notes:
Modified content:

1. In response to the needs of most players, the game Angle has been slightly adjusted. In the Top view, the player sees a wider picture, and in the third person view, the proportion and position of the characters in the picture are adjusted.
2. Modified the HUD display of the player's head, so that it will not appear dramatic when playing the game because of the HUD on the head.
3. Adjusted the key operation of turning chicken and turning person, if you are not used to it, you can modify the key in the game Settings.
4. Fixed the chicken jumping problem, the old version of the chicken will still jump forward when jumping in place, now you can jump in place, if you need to jump forward at the same time press the forward button. At the same time also added the art of chicken jumping, in the second jump, the chicken can roll, but when you carry a head, it can not roll.
5. Fixed the Snail Grilling master having a forward shake jump action when releasing a long tongue attack.
6. Fixed a BUG where the snail form got stuck when climbing the water pipe.
7. Cancelled the custom deep channel of the character's grid body rendering: Now the character will not appear green mask because of being blocked by the wall, according to some player feedback, this blocking performance is optional, but cancelled to improve the feeling of play.
7. Fine-tune the art effects of the first two levels.

Others:

1. Thank you for your attention and support, the game will be corrected from time to time for bugs and deficiencies in level content.
2. The performance effect of the picture art will be slowly modified and adjusted in the later period.
3. As for the English support required by some overseas players, it will also be updated to the game content in the later stage, here I apologize to these players who keep an eye on the game, please wait patiently, the game will consider multi-language support, but not so fast.

notes.title: About Game Fees
notes.notes:
1. The game will be available for payment within the next month or so, but the product cost will not be very high.
2. The fee does not affect players who have already downloaded the game.
3. In order to ensure that updates, new content, and bug fixes continue to be provided to the game, the author needs a steady stream of income from selling the game.
4. Through the charging model, more resources will be invested in game optimization and testing to ensure the stability and fluency of the game.
5. By charging, the author can better protect the copyright and intellectual property rights of the game, prevent piracy and illegal distribution, and ensure that the author's efforts are duly respected and rewarded.
6. I want to attract people who really love the game and are willing to invest in it. The paid model helps me better understand and meet the needs of my core players. It also provides some financial support for new projects that are being prepared.
7. This change is primarily for the long-term health and continued growth of the game, not purely for profit. For those who have already supported the free version, thank you.

notes.title: Modify archive errors
notes.notes:
1. An archive point was added to the waste water area in the second level, and the vulnerability that could not be read in place after being electrocuted by the fallen current support was fixed.
2. Fixed space mosquito generation event in wastewater area.
3. The third level security area has two more archive points to avoid the need to re-read the previous archive after being bitten by a dog.
